name: greg_allen_shed_p1s_scale_1_16
source: Uploaded Greg Allen shed shop drawings
status: first workable model based on visible handwritten dimensions
notes: The uploaded drawings are handwritten/scanned. The visible dimensions used here are front width 45 in, back width 62.25 in, side/depth 85.5 in, side height 60 in, and eave/wall height 45 in.
This first model treats the shed as a tapered footprint: narrower at the front and wider at the back.
The model is scaled 1:16 so it fits within the Bambu Lab P1S 256 mm build volume.
Roof overhang, wall thickness, trim, siding battens, and door details are printable representation assumptions, not confirmed construction dimensions.
